title: "10. Maternal predictors -> juvenile (pre-dispersal) social behaviour -> male rank post-dispersal"
author: "Alba Motes Rodrigo"

output: html_document

# Overview

Tests whether the son's OWN social network position during his juvenile
period (natal group, pre-dispersal) mediates the relationship between
maternal predictors and his rank one year after dispersal — as opposed
to scripts 5-8, which test post-dispersal network position as the
mediator.

Model structure is identical to script 5's validated joint model
(`bf(mediator_z ~ predictor_z, sigma ~ obs_weight) + bf(outcome_z ~
mediator_z + predictor_z, sigma ~ obs_weight) + set_rescor(FALSE)`,
compiled once and reused via `update(..., recompile = FALSE)`), with
one addition: `obs_weight` here reflects observation completeness
during the JUVENILE window, not the post-dispersal window, since that's
the period the mediator was measured in.

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(brms)
library(posterior)

data_dir <- "/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/Pooja_chapter_matrank/Data"
```

```{r load-data}
grooming_data <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "grooming_data2010_2025.csv"))

grooming_data$idindividual2 <- tolower(as.character(grooming_data$idindividual2))

scans$date <- as.Date(scans$date)
```

# Rebuild the juvenile window (needed for juvenile_obs_weight)

```{r}
## 0. Build the juvenile window (same definition as scripts 9-11)

emigrants_full <- emigrants_full %>%
  mutate(
    DOB              = as.Date(DOB),
    DateImmigration1 = as.Date(DateImmigration1),
    DepartureNatalGp = as.Date(DepartureNatalGp),
    dispersal_date   = if_else(!is.na(DateImmigration1), DateImmigration1, DepartureNatalGp),
    juvenile_window_start = DOB + 365,
    juvenile_window_end   = dispersal_date
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    juvenile_window_start = if_else(juvenile_window_start < juvenile_window_end,
                                     juvenile_window_start, as.Date(NA)),
    juvenile_window_end   = if_else(!is.na(juvenile_window_start), juvenile_window_end, as.Date(NA))
  )

## 1a. Maternal grooming investment

emigrants_full$mom_groom_days_to_son <- NA
emigrants_full$mom_total_groom_days <- NA
emigrants_full$mom_groom_proportion <- NA

for (i in seq_len(nrow(emigrants_full))) {
  mom <- emigrants_full$Momcode[i]; son <- emigrants_full$Code[i]
  grp <- emigrants_full$BirthGp[i]
  window_start <- emigrants_full$juvenile_window_start[i]
  window_end   <- emigrants_full$juvenile_window_end[i]

  if (any(is.na(c(mom, son, grp))) || is.na(window_start) || is.na(window_end) ||
      mom == "" || son == "") next

  mom_groom <- grooming_data %>%
    filter(idindividual1 == mom, group_Abbreviation == grp,
           date >= window_start, date <= window_end)

  if (nrow(mom_groom) == 0) next

  total_days <- n_distinct(mom_groom$date)
  days_to_son <- mom_groom %>% filter(idindividual2 == son) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(date)) %>% pull(n)

  emigrants_full$mom_groom_days_to_son[i] <- days_to_son
  emigrants_full$mom_total_groom_days[i]  <- total_days
  emigrants_full$mom_groom_proportion[i]  <- days_to_son / total_days
}

cat("mom_groom_proportion coverage (new window):\n")
sum(!is.na(emigrants_full$mom_groom_proportion))

## 1b. Maternal proximity investment

close_categories <- c("Holding/Clinging", "Contact", "Arm's Length", "Around (<5m)", "<5m")
emigrants_full$mom_prox_with_son <- NA
emigrants_full$mom_son_total_scans <- NA
emigrants_full$mom_prox_proportion <- NA

for (i in seq_len(nrow(emigrants_full))) {
  mom <- emigrants_full$Momcode[i]; son <- emigrants_full$Code[i]
  grp <- emigrants_full$BirthGp[i]
  window_start <- emigrants_full$juvenile_window_start[i]
  window_end   <- emigrants_full$juvenile_window_end[i]

  if (any(is.na(c(mom, son, grp))) || is.na(window_start) || is.na(window_end) ||
      mom == "" || son == "") next

  mom_scans <- scans %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    filter(tolower(idindividual1) == mom, group_Abbreviation == grp,
           date >= window_start, date <= window_end)

  if (nrow(mom_scans) == 0) next

  n_total <- nrow(mom_scans)
  n_close <- sum(mom_scans$infant %in% close_categories, na.rm = TRUE)

  emigrants_full$mom_prox_with_son[i]   <- n_close
  emigrants_full$mom_son_total_scans[i] <- n_total
  emigrants_full$mom_prox_proportion[i] <- n_close / n_total
}

cat("mom_prox_proportion coverage (new window):\n")
sum(!is.na(emigrants_full$mom_prox_proportion))#78
```

# Compute juvenile_obs_weight

Raw count of days present during the juvenile window (NOT a proportion
of window length, unlike the post-dispersal `obs_weight` in script 5).
A raw count is more appropriate here than a ratio: because the juvenile
window varies from ~1 year to several years across males, a male
observed on 200 days out of a 4-year window has substantially more data
underlying his network/rank estimate than the same 200-day count would
imply for a male with a 1-year window — the raw count better reflects
actual observation density feeding the `sigma ~ obs_weight` term than a
ratio would.

```{r compute-juvenile-obs-weight}
compute_juvenile_days_present <- function(natal_group, window_start, window_end,
                                          Code, group_presence_matrices) {
  if (any(is.na(c(natal_group, window_start, window_end, Code))) ||
      !natal_group %in% names(group_presence_matrices)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  pm <- group_presence_matrices[[natal_group]] %>%
    filter(Date >= as.Date(window_start), Date <= as.Date(window_end))
  if (nrow(pm) == 0 || !Code %in% names(pm)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(pm[[Code]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
}

emigrants_full <- emigrants_full %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    juvenile_obs_weight = compute_juvenile_days_present(
      natal_group = BirthGp,
      window_start = juvenile_window_start,
      window_end = juvenile_window_end,
      Code = Code,
      group_presence_matrices = group_presence_matrices
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("juvenile_obs_weight (raw days present) summary:\n")
summary(emigrants_full$juvenile_obs_weight)
emigrants_full$juvenile_obs_weight
```

# Summary + convergence helpers (identical to script 5)

```{r helpers}
summarize_network_draws <- function(estimates) {
  tibble(
    estimate_mean   = mean(estimates),
    estimate_median = median(estimates),
    network_q025    = quantile(estimates, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    network_q975    = quantile(estimates, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    prop_positive   = mean(estimates > 0),
    prop_negative   = mean(estimates < 0)
  )
}

check_joint_convergence <- function(fit, rhat_threshold = 1.01, ess_threshold = 400) {
  summ <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit))
  bad_rhat <- summ %>% filter(rhat > rhat_threshold)
  bad_ess  <- summ %>% filter(ess_bulk < ess_threshold | ess_tail < ess_threshold)
  ok <- nrow(bad_rhat) == 0 && nrow(bad_ess) == 0
  if (!ok) {
    cat("    CONVERGENCE WARNING:\n")
    if (nrow(bad_rhat) > 0) { cat("    Parameters with Rhat >", rhat_threshold, ":\n"); print(bad_rhat %>% select(variable, rhat)) }
    if (nrow(bad_ess) > 0)  { cat("    Parameters with ESS <", ess_threshold, ":\n");  print(bad_ess %>% select(variable, ess_bulk, ess_tail)) }
  }
  list(ok = ok, max_rhat = max(summ$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
       min_ess = min(c(summ$ess_bulk, summ$ess_tail), na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

# Joint Bayesian mediation function

Same structure as `run_bison_mediation_bayesian_joint()` (script 5),
generalised to accept which predictor column to use, and using
`juvenile_obs_weight` in place of the post-dispersal `obs_weight`.

```{r mediation-function}
run_juvenile_mediation_bayesian_joint <- function(emigrants_full, predictor_col, predictor_label, spec,
                                                    num_draws, chains = 2, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000,
                                                    adapt_delta = 0.95) {

  cat("Running JUVENILE-MEDIATOR joint mediation:", predictor_label, "->", spec$name, "\n")

  sem_data <- emigrants_full %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[predictor_col]]),
           !is.na(elo_one_year_male_male),
           !is.na(juvenile_obs_weight))

  males_with_posteriors <- sem_data$Code[sem_data$Code %in% names(spec$posteriors)]
  dat <- sem_data %>% filter(Code %in% males_with_posteriors)

  if (nrow(dat) < 10) {
    cat("  Too few males with posteriors:", nrow(dat), "- skipping\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  cat("  n =", nrow(dat), "\n")

  first_post <- spec$posteriors[[males_with_posteriors[1]]][[spec$field]]
  actual_draws <- length(first_post)
  num_draws <- min(num_draws, actual_draws)

  predictor_center <- mean(dat[[predictor_col]])
  predictor_scale  <- sd(dat[[predictor_col]])
  
  obs_weight_center <- mean(dat$juvenile_obs_weight, na.rm = TRUE)
  obs_weight_scale  <- sd(dat$juvenile_obs_weight, na.rm = TRUE)

  mediator_point_estimates <- sapply(dat$Code, function(id) {
    mean(spec$posteriors[[id]][[spec$field]][1:num_draws])
  })
  mediator_center <- mean(mediator_point_estimates)
  mediator_scale   <- sd(mediator_point_estimates)

  build_draw_data <- function(k) {
    dat_k <- dat
    dat_k$mediator    <- sapply(dat_k$Code, function(id) spec$posteriors[[id]][[spec$field]][k])
    dat_k$predictor_z <- (dat_k[[predictor_col]] - predictor_center) / predictor_scale
    dat_k$male_elo_z  <- scale(dat_k$elo_one_year_male_male)[, 1]
    dat_k$mediator_z  <- (dat_k$mediator - mediator_center) / mediator_scale
    dat_k$obs_weight  <- (dat_k$juvenile_obs_weight - obs_weight_center) / obs_weight_scale
    dat_k
  }

  dat_1 <- build_draw_data(1)

  bf_mediator <- bf(mediator_z ~ predictor_z, sigma ~ obs_weight)
  bf_outcome  <- bf(male_elo_z ~ mediator_z + predictor_z, sigma ~ obs_weight)

  cat("  Compiling joint Stan model (draw 1)...\n")
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  fit_base <- brm(
    bf_mediator + bf_outcome + set_rescor(FALSE),
    data = dat_1, family = gaussian(),
    chains = chains, iter = iter, warmup = warmup,
    seed = 1, refresh = 0, silent = 2,
    control = list(adapt_delta = adapt_delta)
  )

  compile_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
  cat("  Compilation + first fit took", round(compile_time, 1), "seconds\n")

  conv1 <- check_joint_convergence(fit_base)
  if (!conv1$ok) {
    cat("  WARNING: draw 1 did not converge cleanly (max Rhat =",
        round(conv1$max_rhat, 4), ", min ESS =", round(conv1$min_ess, 1), ") - inspect before proceeding\n")
  }

  a_all <- numeric(0); b_all <- numeric(0); c_all <- numeric(0); ind_all <- numeric(0)

  for (k in 1:num_draws) {

    dat_k <- if (k == 1) dat_1 else build_draw_data(k)
    fit_k <- if (k == 1) fit_base else update(fit_base, newdata = dat_k, recompile = FALSE, refresh = 0, silent = 2)

    post_k <- as_draws_df(fit_k)

    a_post   <- post_k$b_mediatorz_predictor_z
    b_post   <- post_k$b_maleeloz_mediator_z
    c_post   <- post_k$b_maleeloz_predictor_z
    ind_post <- a_post * b_post

    a_all   <- c(a_all, a_post)
    b_all   <- c(b_all, b_post)
    c_all   <- c(c_all, c_post)
    ind_all <- c(ind_all, ind_post)
  }

  tot_all <- c_all + ind_all

  results <- bind_rows(
    summarize_network_draws(a_all)   %>% mutate(path = "a (predictor -> juvenile mediator)"),
    summarize_network_draws(b_all)   %>% mutate(path = "b (juvenile mediator -> male elo)"),
    summarize_network_draws(c_all)   %>% mutate(path = "c' (predictor -> male elo, direct)"),
    summarize_network_draws(ind_all) %>% mutate(path = "indirect (a * b)"),
    summarize_network_draws(tot_all) %>% mutate(path = "c (total effect)")
  ) %>%
    mutate(predictor = predictor_label, mediator = spec$name,
           n = nrow(dat), num_draws = num_draws, .before = 1)

  cat("\n  === Results:", predictor_label, "->", spec$name, "(n =", nrow(dat), ") ===\n")
  for (j in 1:nrow(results)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-40s mean = %6.3f  95%% CI [%6.3f, %6.3f]  pd = %4.1f%%\n",
                results$path[j], results$estimate_mean[j],
                results$network_q025[j], results$network_q975[j],
                max(results$prop_positive[j], results$prop_negative[j]) * 100))
  }
  cat("\n")

  list(summary = results, pooled_posterior = tibble(a = a_all, b = b_all, c_prime = c_all, indirect = ind_all))
}
```

# Joint Bayesian mediation function — maternal-network predictors

Same joint model structure as `run_juvenile_mediation_bayesian_joint()`
above, but for predictors that are themselves posterior draws (maternal
grooming/proximity eigen-centrality from script 7) rather than a fixed
observed column. Draws a fresh sample of the mother's network position
on every iteration `k`, matched to her via the `mom_key` prefix system
from script 7, so predictor-side uncertainty is propagated through the
mediation exactly like the mediator- and outcome-side uncertainty
already is.

```{r mom-key-match}
build_predictor_sem_data_juv <- function(emigrants_full, predictor_posteriors) {
  emigrants_full %>%
    mutate(mom_key_prefix = paste0(Momcode, "_")) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(mom_key = {
      matches <- names(predictor_posteriors)[startsWith(names(predictor_posteriors), mom_key_prefix)]
      if (length(matches) == 0) NA_character_ else matches[1]
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

```{r mediation-function-eigen}
run_juvenile_mediation_bayesian_joint_eigen <- function(emigrants_full, predictor_posteriors,
                                                          predictor_field, predictor_label, spec,
                                                          num_draws, chains = 2, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000,
                                                          adapt_delta = 0.95) {

  cat("Running JUVENILE-MEDIATOR joint mediation (maternal-network predictor):",
      predictor_label, "->", spec$name, "\n")

  sem_data <- build_predictor_sem_data_juv(emigrants_full, predictor_posteriors) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mom_key),
           !is.na(elo_one_year_male_male),
           !is.na(juvenile_obs_weight))

  males_with_posteriors <- sem_data$Code[sem_data$Code %in% names(spec$posteriors)]
  dat <- sem_data %>% filter(Code %in% males_with_posteriors)

  if (nrow(dat) < 10) {
    cat("  Too few males with posteriors:", nrow(dat), "- skipping\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  cat("  n =", nrow(dat), "\n")

  first_mediator_post  <- spec$posteriors[[males_with_posteriors[1]]][[spec$field]]
  first_predictor_post <- predictor_posteriors[[dat$mom_key[1]]][[predictor_field]]
  actual_draws <- min(length(first_mediator_post), length(first_predictor_post))
  num_draws <- min(num_draws, actual_draws)

  predictor_point_estimates <- sapply(dat$mom_key, function(key) {
    mean(predictor_posteriors[[key]][[predictor_field]][1:num_draws], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  predictor_center <- mean(predictor_point_estimates)
  predictor_scale  <- sd(predictor_point_estimates)

  obs_weight_center <- mean(dat$juvenile_obs_weight, na.rm = TRUE)
  obs_weight_scale  <- sd(dat$juvenile_obs_weight, na.rm = TRUE)

  mediator_point_estimates <- sapply(dat$Code, function(id) {
    mean(spec$posteriors[[id]][[spec$field]][1:num_draws])
  })
  mediator_center <- mean(mediator_point_estimates)
  mediator_scale  <- sd(mediator_point_estimates)

  build_draw_data <- function(k) {
    dat_k <- dat
    dat_k$mediator      <- sapply(dat_k$Code,    function(id)  spec$posteriors[[id]][[spec$field]][k])
    dat_k$predictor_raw <- sapply(dat_k$mom_key, function(key) predictor_posteriors[[key]][[predictor_field]][k])
    dat_k$predictor_z   <- (dat_k$predictor_raw - predictor_center) / predictor_scale
    dat_k$male_elo_z    <- scale(dat_k$elo_one_year_male_male)[, 1]
    dat_k$mediator_z    <- (dat_k$mediator - mediator_center) / mediator_scale
    dat_k$obs_weight    <- (dat_k$juvenile_obs_weight - obs_weight_center) / obs_weight_scale
    dat_k
  }

  dat_1 <- build_draw_data(1)

  bf_mediator <- bf(mediator_z ~ predictor_z, sigma ~ obs_weight)
  bf_outcome  <- bf(male_elo_z ~ mediator_z + predictor_z, sigma ~ obs_weight)

  cat("  Compiling joint Stan model (draw 1)...\n")
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  fit_base <- brm(
    bf_mediator + bf_outcome + set_rescor(FALSE),
    data = dat_1, family = gaussian(),
    chains = chains, iter = iter, warmup = warmup,
    seed = 1, refresh = 0, silent = 2,
    control = list(adapt_delta = adapt_delta)
  )

  compile_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
  cat("  Compilation + first fit took", round(compile_time, 1), "seconds\n")

  conv1 <- check_joint_convergence(fit_base)
  if (!conv1$ok) {
    cat("  WARNING: draw 1 did not converge cleanly (max Rhat =",
        round(conv1$max_rhat, 4), ", min ESS =", round(conv1$min_ess, 1), ") - inspect before proceeding\n")
  }

  a_all <- numeric(0); b_all <- numeric(0); c_all <- numeric(0); ind_all <- numeric(0)

  for (k in 1:num_draws) {

    dat_k <- if (k == 1) dat_1 else build_draw_data(k)
    fit_k <- if (k == 1) fit_base else update(fit_base, newdata = dat_k, recompile = FALSE, refresh = 0, silent = 2)

    post_k <- as_draws_df(fit_k)

    a_post   <- post_k$b_mediatorz_predictor_z
    b_post   <- post_k$b_maleeloz_mediator_z
    c_post   <- post_k$b_maleeloz_predictor_z
    ind_post <- a_post * b_post

    a_all   <- c(a_all, a_post)
    b_all   <- c(b_all, b_post)
    c_all   <- c(c_all, c_post)
    ind_all <- c(ind_all, ind_post)
  }

  tot_all <- c_all + ind_all

  results <- bind_rows(
    summarize_network_draws(a_all)   %>% mutate(path = "a (predictor -> juvenile mediator)"),
    summarize_network_draws(b_all)   %>% mutate(path = "b (juvenile mediator -> male elo)"),
    summarize_network_draws(c_all)   %>% mutate(path = "c' (predictor -> male elo, direct)"),
    summarize_network_draws(ind_all) %>% mutate(path = "indirect (a * b)"),
    summarize_network_draws(tot_all) %>% mutate(path = "c (total effect)")
  ) %>%
    mutate(predictor = predictor_label, mediator = spec$name,
           n = nrow(dat), num_draws = num_draws, .before = 1)

  cat("\n  === Results:", predictor_label, "->", spec$name, "(n =", nrow(dat), ") ===\n")
  for (j in 1:nrow(results)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-40s mean = %6.3f  95%% CI [%6.3f, %6.3f]  pd = %4.1f%%\n",
                results$path[j], results$estimate_mean[j],
                results$network_q025[j], results$network_q975[j],
                max(results$prop_positive[j], results$prop_negative[j]) * 100))
  }
  cat("\n")

  list(summary = results, pooled_posterior = tibble(a = a_all, b = b_all, c_prime = c_all, indirect = ind_all))
}
```

# FULL RUN — predictor: maternal rank

```{r run-full-bayesian, eval=T}

predictor_list <- list(
  list(col = "mom_groom_proportion",        label = "Maternal grooming investment"),
  list(col = "mom_prox_proportion",         label = "Maternal proximity investment"),
  #list(col = "mother_presence_proportion",  label = "Maternal presence"),
  #list(col = "n_earlier_offspring",         label = "Maternal parity"),
  list(col = "mother_avg_elo",              label = "Maternal rank")
)

all_results_juv <- list()
all_pooled_juv   <- list()

for (pred in predictor_list) {

  if (!pred$col %in% names(emigrants_full)) {
    cat("\n>>> SKIPPING predictor '", pred$label, "' - column '", pred$col,
        "' not found in emigrants_full\n", sep = "")
    next
  }

  for (spec in mediator_specs) {

    run_key <- paste(pred$label, spec$name, sep = " -> ")
    cat("\n>>> Starting", run_key, "at", format(Sys.time()), "\n")

    out <- tryCatch(
      run_juvenile_mediation_bayesian_joint(
        emigrants_full, pred$col, pred$label, spec,
        num_draws = 1000, chains = 2, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("  ERROR for", run_key, ":", e$message, "\n")
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (!is.null(out)) {
      all_results_juv[[run_key]] <- out$summary
      all_pooled_juv[[run_key]]  <- out$pooled_posterior

      tryCatch({
        saveRDS(all_results_juv,
                file.path(data_dir, "juvenile_mediation_results_bayesian_ALL_PARTIAL.rds"))
        saveRDS(all_pooled_juv,
                file.path(data_dir, "juvenile_mediation_pooled_posteriors_ALL_PARTIAL.rds"))
        cat("  Saved progress after", run_key, "\n")
      }, error = function(e) cat("  WARNING: save failed after", run_key, "-", e$message, "\n"))
    }
  }
}

# ── Maternal-network predictors (posterior-propagated) ──────────────────
# These were computed in script 7 (mother_groom_eigen_posteriors /
# mother_prox_eigen_posteriors) but never loaded into this script until
# now - see the "Load data" chunk above. Appending into the same
# all_results_juv / all_pooled_juv lists as the loop above, so they end
# up merged into full_summary_juv below.

maternal_predictor_list <- list(
  list(posteriors = mother_groom_eigen_posteriors, field = "mom_groom_eigen",
       label = "Mother grooming eigen-centrality"),
  list(posteriors = mother_prox_eigen_posteriors,  field = "mom_prox_eigen",
       label = "Mother proximity eigen-centrality")
)

for (pred in maternal_predictor_list) {
  for (spec in mediator_specs) {

    run_key <- paste(pred$label, spec$name, sep = " -> ")
    cat("\n>>> Starting", run_key, "at", format(Sys.time()), "\n")

    out <- tryCatch(
      run_juvenile_mediation_bayesian_joint_eigen(
        emigrants_full, pred$posteriors, pred$field, pred$label, spec,
        num_draws = 1000, chains = 2, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("  ERROR for", run_key, ":", e$message, "\n")
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (!is.null(out)) {
      all_results_juv[[run_key]] <- out$summary
      all_pooled_juv[[run_key]]  <- out$pooled_posterior

      tryCatch({
        saveRDS(all_results_juv,
                file.path(data_dir, "juvenile_mediation_results_bayesian_ALL_PARTIAL.rds"))
        saveRDS(all_pooled_juv,
                file.path(data_dir, "juvenile_mediation_pooled_posteriors_ALL_PARTIAL.rds"))
        cat("  Saved progress after", run_key, "\n")
      }, error = function(e) cat("  WARNING: save failed after", run_key, "-", e$message, "\n"))
    }
  }
}

full_summary_juv <- bind_rows(all_results_juv)

# Back up the existing file before overwriting it - it may still hold
# results from an earlier version of predictor_list (see conversation
# history: this file previously had "Mother grooming eigen-centrality"
# rows from a prior run even though predictor_list didn't produce them
# this session).
existing_csv <- file.path(data_dir, "juvenile_mediation_all_predictors_bayesian.csv")
if (file.exists(existing_csv)) {
  file.copy(existing_csv,
            file.path(data_dir, paste0("juvenile_mediation_all_predictors_bayesian_backup_",
                                        format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"), ".csv")),
            overwrite = FALSE)
}

write.csv(full_summary_juv,
          file.path("/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/Pooja_chapter_matrank/Data/juvenile_mediation_all_predictors_bayesian.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(all_pooled_juv,
        file.path(data_dir, "juvenile_mediation_pooled_posteriors_all_predictors.rds"))

cat("\nDone. Final results saved:",
    file.path(data_dir, "juvenile_mediation_all_predictors_bayesian.csv"), "\n")
print(as.data.frame(full_summary_juv), row.names = FALSE)

# Sample sizes per predictor
full_summary_juv %>%
  distinct(predictor, mediator, n) %>%
  arrange(predictor, mediator) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Credible effects only (95% CI excludes zero)

  filter(sign(network_q025) == sign(network_q975)) %>%
```

Higher ranking mothers have sons with higher frequency of proximity interactions
(mean β = 0.387, 95% CI [0.022, 0.751], pd = 98.1%)

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

full_summary_juv <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "juvenile_mediation_all_predictors_bayesian.csv"))

predictor_label_map <- c(
  "Maternal grooming investment"      = "Maternal grooming investment",
  "Maternal proximity investment"     = "Maternal proximity investment",
  "Maternal rank"                     = "Maternal rank",
  "Mother grooming eigen-centrality"  = "Mother grooming eigen-centrality",
  "Mother proximity eigen-centrality" = "Mother proximity eigen-centrality"
)

mediator_label_map <- c(
  "prox_strength_juv"      = "Prox strength",
  "prox_degree_juv"        = "Prox degree",
  "groom_out_strength_juv" = "Groom out-strength",
  "groom_in_strength_juv"  = "Groom in-strength",
  "groom_out_degree_juv"   = "Groom out-degree",
  "groom_in_degree_juv"    = "Groom in-degree"
)

plot_data_juv <- full_summary_juv %>%
  filter(path == "a (predictor -> juvenile mediator)", predictor != "Maternal presence") %>%
  mutate(
    predictor_label = predictor_label_map[predictor],
    mediator_label   = mediator_label_map[mediator],
    predictor_label  = ifelse(is.na(predictor_label), predictor, predictor_label),
    mediator_label   = ifelse(is.na(mediator_label), mediator, mediator_label),
    excludes_zero = sign(network_q025) == sign(network_q975),
    direction = ifelse(estimate_mean > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
    ci_type = ifelse(excludes_zero, "solid", "dashed")
  ) %>%
  arrange(predictor, desc(estimate_mean))

plot_data_juv$mediator_label <- factor(
  plot_data_juv$mediator_label,
  levels = unique(plot_data_juv$mediator_label[order(plot_data_juv$estimate_mean)])
)

ggplot(plot_data_juv, aes(x = mediator_label, y = estimate_mean, color = direction)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = network_q025, ymax = network_q975, linetype = ci_type),
                 linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  scale_linetype_identity() +
  facet_wrap(~ predictor_label, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Positive" = "#2E7D32", "Negative" = "#C62828"), name = NULL) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Posterior mean and 95% network-draw range"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 17) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "plain"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey40", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
